The '''Shadow IV Civilian Airspeeder''' was a type of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] that was built by [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]]. One was used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Thaereian military]], to attack the [[Heroes of Cularin]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was a civilian version of the [[Shadow V Combat Airspeeder]].
